title: オークスの後に・ヒロインは

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I gave it everything I had, but I wasn't able to win…)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But… But!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Bouncing back from defeat to claim victory is a common trope!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Princess…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: I just know you'll do better in the next race! I can't wait to see you win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess keeps her head held high and pushes onward. Nobody can stand in my path!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No good story is without its twists and turns. It simply wasn't the right time for my victory.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But since I'm the heroine of this story, I have to make sure…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That there'll be a happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Princess! I know you can win the next one!

text_block_list.name: Girls
text_block_list.text: Go, Princess, go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she lost, Kawakami Princess remains confident as she's showered by encouraging cheers.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: Why are they acting like she's the only star of this race? The rest of the racers tried just as hard…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, while I'm having Kawakami Princess rest in the waiting room…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock…

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. That was a great race out there today. I work on the show Meet the Racers!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you the one who made that special promo video?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Every door, every wall, and every competitor crumbles! The Princess has entered the fray!"

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right! And so, I wanted to come and consult with you about something.

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text: You were really amazing out there, which is why I was hoping you'd consider doing a collaboration with our show!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Maybe calling it a special would be more fitting. I'd like to put together a live broadcast showing you speak passionately about your next objective!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …My next objective.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to enter the Shuka Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's the last race of the Tiara tour. I've lost the Japanese Oaks, but that doesn't mean I'll let anyone else take the final prize.
choice_data_list: You bet. The Shuka Sho it is.
You bet. The Shuka Sho it is.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll come back from this defeat and claim victory! Now's the time to show my grit and determination!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Kawakami Princess zealously proclaims her goal, the TV station staff member watches with a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next objective is the Shuka Sho.
